component: NNTP folder ordering and folder-pane drag/drop

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The newsgroup ordering patch removes the private 9000-based order and reorderGroup API and uses the generic folder drag flavor. News folders then use inherited effective sortOrder: a stored manual userSortOrder wins, otherwise normal equal-rank folders compare localized names with the shared numeric collator. Thus default name sorting does not erase explicit manual order or establish ASCII order. Current drag insertion remains restricted by same-server, single-folder and all-mode checks, plus hierarchy guards; the NNTP drag effect is move-only. The former native newsrc-write reorder path is removed, and this patch adds no migration or ordering test. No drag, restart, persistence or accessibility result was produced.
title: News folders use shared effective order and generic drag insertion
